# Starton

Starton is an all-in-one Web3 API platform that enables developers to deploy and interact with smart contracts, store files on IPFS, and monitor blockchain events through a unified API and frontend interface.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/starton/.

## Actions

- **Delete Smart Contract Event**: Delete a specific smart contract event watcher by its id.
- **Get smart contract deployments**: Retrieve a list of smart contract deployments.
- **Get Smart Contract Event**: Retrieve details of a specific smart contract event watcher by its id.
- **Get Smart Contracts**: Retrieve a list of all smart contracts associated with your project.
- **Get Templates**: Retrieve a list of all smart contract templates.
- **Get Watcher**: Retrieve details of a specific watcher by its id.
- **Get Watchers**: Retrieve a list of all watchers monitoring blockchain events.
- **Get Webhooks**: Retrieve a list of all webhook watchers.
- **Upload File to IPFS**: Upload a file to your project's ipfs storage.
